entries.original_question: Conjecture1 asks closure of edge-factorizing binary MTP2 Markov distributions; Conjectures2/3 ask broader factorization.

entries.explicit_domain: Finite simple binary graph, arbitrary zero supports; no hidden variables or additional edges. Signed real source factors are explicitly reconciled; isolated/empty graph conventions stated.
